subject: Science
description: Explain combustion, reactions of acids with metals, reactions of acids with carbonates, and acid rain damage using environmental and Philippine local contexts.
learningObjectives: Describe combustion as a rapid reaction with oxygen that releases heat and light
Explain how acids react with many metals to produce a salt and hydrogen gas
Explain how acids react with carbonates to produce a salt, water, and carbon dioxide
Connect environmental chemical reactions to fuel use, corrosion, acid rain, and damage to natural and built structures
prerequisites: Basic properties of acids, bases, and salts
Combination, decomposition, single replacement, and double replacement reaction patterns
Reactants and products in word equations
